svg.title: Blue Panel
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Complete blue quadrilateral in gallery reference. Public caption has contradictory dimensions (55×52in versus140×142cm), so normalized observed ratio only; source dimension fields remain unknown.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-an-installation-seven-new-paintings-10-1996/lightbox/works/blue-panel-1996-3729; record matthewmarks-blue-panel-1996-3729; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
